opening.argument: The video pairs a “Zero Risk” and “$ 500 daily” promise with instructions to create and fund a trading contract. It tells viewers to connect a wallet to Remix, send funds to the contract, and activate automated buying and selling through the Pancake router. The promotional case is reinforced by claims of “several hundred BNB,” a result “around 15x,” and potential earnings of “a thousand BNB day” when using more funds. Those claims are tied to sending money into the contract and using the bot, while the stated refund, profit, and retained-funds outcomes are not verified. The presentation therefore asks viewers to treat a funded-contract trading process as a low-risk route to unusually large returns.
